Sam / Nina — appreciated the clarity. We propose the following compromise text for the Order Form (summary):

- Redwood will not retrain or use customer production data to update public models without explicit opt-in.
- For a listed set of "Product Features" in the Order Form (Annex A), Redwood grants a time-limited license to develop and ship the specific features; assignment remains with Redwood but customer receives a perpetual, non-exclusive license for their internal use and productization within defined channels.
- Telemetry: Redwood will provide a sanitized exemplar and a retention SOP as procurement evidence; access to raw telemetry is limited and can be made available under a separate, auditable process (audit window + NDA).

If that summary looks acceptable we will send a marked-up MSA + Order Form with exact language. Also: Karthik confirmed a minimal exemplar by Thursday morning; please let us know whether that suffices for your procurement team or whether you need the fuller set.
